notes: Parse inputJson exactly, without trimming, BOM removal, URL handling, or manifest validation.
A parser SyntaxError is mapped by the harness to OWA_INVALID_JSON. Successful parses compare static canonicalJson and digest.
Duplicate decoded JSON object names at any depth reject as OWA_INVALID_JSON_VALUE, including overwritten invalid values; unpaired-surrogate parser limitations remain disclosed.
